_metadata.description: OT-P0-005 — baseline-aware validation: compute the exact check set, run on request, verify DoD.

requirements.title: Compute the exact baseline/validation command set from connected code
requirements.description: From a plan's connected code, derive the precise set of baseline/validation commands needed across all affected locations (not just scenarios) — so the agent does not have to reason about which scenarios to baseline.

validation.notes: Command-set derivation maps connected code -> minimal baseline/diff command set; target api/internal/validation.

requirements.title: Run validation on request and verify DoD against the regression anchor
requirements.description: On request (agent in the loop) the scenario runs the computed checks and returns results + staleness, and verifies Definition-of-Done against the regression anchor as an oracle rather than relying on a narrated claim. Agents may run baselines; they never commit.

validation.notes: Runner behind a seam; DoD verdict derives from baseline diff exit status; target api/internal/validation.
E2E: run computed baselines for a plan and surface pass/regression + staleness.
